sec.title: Night map
sec.p: Gold is the grid. The dark is still Country.

NASA Black Marble 2016 (Suomi NPP VIIRS) is a remote-sensing composite of night-time lights. It is a photo of electricity, not of the country. Credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Joshua Stevens; VIIRS data Miguel Román, NASA GSFC. Public domain. No cities added.

sec.title: Consent and latency
sec.p: Unlabelled speech is rejected. An action without a grant is fail-closed. Memory is kept off the model. Earth–Mars one-way delay is typically 4–24 minutes, labelled as delay, not a toy.
The engine is public. 137/137 automated checks re-verified 10 August 2026. Lattice and mesh remain designed, not built.

sec.title: What this pack does not claim
sec.p: It does not select a site. It does not claim a recovery berth, a contracted megawatt load at Aerotropolis West, a Telstra or Qantas or Starlink partnership, native satellite voice, or 000 via Direct to Cell. CARE is cited, not worn. CrystalCore is not Indigenous data governance.
